description.value: The Reach Gallery Museum is the Fraser Valley's primary civic cultural institution, presenting a year-round schedule of visual arts exhibitions alongside a permanent community history museum and an archive of approximately 46,000 local historical images. It has received multiple Governor General's History Awards and BC Museums Association honours for its community engagement programming. A touring cyclist exploring the Abbotsford area will find rotating exhibitions, deep regional history collections, and a welcoming atmosphere noted by visitors for its accessibility.

bike_parking_detail: 5 racks within 100m: wave (3 spaces) at 32m; rack (3 spaces) at 73m; wide_stands (3 spaces) at 78m; rack (3 spaces) at 86m; wide_stands (4 spaces) at 99m. Total: 16 spaces.
